gen-righteous-gf-glegoo: Full bowls, rod-bent lines, loads of swagger: that's Righteous. Glegoo keeps its tall, open-mouthed lowercase flowing, so long pages of text move along steadily with a refined, editorial ease.
gen-righteous-gf-hanuman: Righteous fills each line with chunky bowls and a marker-like stroke that never thins out, bold and a bit playful. Hanuman reads in a refined, traditional way, its high-waisted lowercase easy over stretches.
gen-righteous-gf-pridi: Righteous is all rope-like strokes and bowls that fill the line. It does loud, commanding display best, while Pridi earns its keep with small letters standing proud and generous curve openings.
gen-flavors-fs-epilogue: Stubby-pencil towers, whimsical and loud: that's all Flavors. Epilogue slips underneath with friendly, wire-thin monoline curves and a tall-bodied lowercase, so the heading's heft gets plenty of room to breathe.
gen-tourney-gf-glegoo: Bent tubing, stretched wide, pure muscle: that's Tourney. Glegoo brings a refined, editorial lowercase with big counters and tall, open curves, giving the loud heading something quieter to lean on.
gen-tourney-gf-kadwa: Wide-tracked, single-width strokes and bulky small letters: that's Tourney at full volume, all pure athletic punch. Kadwa settles the page down with open curves and a large x-height.
gen-tourney-gf-scope-one: Tourney hits hard, with uniform strokes, wide tracking and oversized small letters. Scope One tempers it with stubby ascenders, a big x-height and counters that spill into surrounding space.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-fira-sans: Wide-set, bold and commanding, that's Goldman all over. It does shouty, attention-grabbing display best, while Fira Sans handles text with wide-opening s curves, uniform strokes and a large x-height.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-pilcrow-r: Spaced-out letters and a high x-height make Alien Encounters feel technological, like a signal from somewhere far off. Pilcrow Rounded tucks in close and warm beneath it, curves left open.
gen-dafont-arkhip-fs-synonym: Modern and geometric, Arkhip floats its letters apart, with a c as open as a bent paperclip. Synonym adds a dependable stripe of constant ink beneath, quietly letting it lead.
